abstract: Exhaustive guide for evaluating Kotlin, Java, Flutter, React Native, and Expo app code against Google Play Developer Program Policies. Covers ALL major sections: Section 1 Restricted Content (sexual content, hate speech, violence, financial services, real-money gambling), Section 2 Impersonation & IP (copyright, trademark, impersonation), Section 3 Privacy & Security (user data, permissions, malware, deceptive behavior, Device and Network Abuse), Section 4 Monetization & Ads (Google Play Billing, subscriptions, ad networks, disruptive ads, Families Policy), Section 5 Store Listing & Promotion (metadata, user ratings, incentivized downloads), and Section 6 Spam & Functionality (repetitive content, webviews, broken apps, crash/ANR threshold). Includes code patterns to flag, checklists for each guideline, and pre-submission verification.
